summary: Repligen Corporation filed an 8-K on October 6, 2026, disclosing completion of its previously announced acquisition of BioLife Solutions, Inc. via a two-step merger under the July 21, 2026 Agreement and Plan of Merger. BioLife holders received per-share consideration of 0.1442 Repligen shares plus $11.25 cash, with cash in lieu of fractional shares. The Form S-4 was declared effective September 4, 2026, alongside BioLife's definitive proxy. Mechanics include appraisal-rights carve-outs and option treatment. Watch integration execution, stock-consideration dilution, and any dissenting-share appraisal claims.
